cohort: The study included 139 patients undergoing robot-assisted laparoscopic hysterectomy and 291 patients undergoing total laparoscopic hysterectomy for gynecologic benign disease.
finding: Robot-assisted laparoscopic hysterectomy (RAH) resulted in statistically better surgical outcomes regarding net operative time and blood loss compared to total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH), regardless of surgeon experience.
